assertion_audit.fails_if: the decoded record has incorrect grid, polarity, verdict, or wall dimensions
the writer and reader disagree on a recorded scalar or array; a symmetric codec error can survive
the emitted header, fixed sample dimensions, flags, number spelling, or line count changes
any evaluated value, gradient component, or Hessian component departs from scipy's independent spline by its asserted tolerance
JAX grad, vmap, or Hessian derivative yields a nonfinite result; finite but incorrect results survive
the synthetic export omits the file/header, fails to map a supplied decision field, or alters the source grid or wall; measured decisions are not tested
serializing the first serialized file changes its bytes; a consistent writer-reader corruption survives

findings.text: blocking: the sweep catches both synthetic crossing failures and skips them, while 14 of 24 paired rows are unread and five more unqualified, so the requested case-by-case boundary decision cannot be compared for every input.
blocking: the delivered 550-cell trace was generated at offset 0.0 rather than a bisected tie-island offset, so one of the requested exchanged states is absent.

follow-on: TraceSplineField duplicates the not-a-knot JAX tensor spline and its first and second derivatives already owned by nova/linalg/tensor_spline.py:264-325; it neither extends nor wraps that owner.
follow-on: the second export is made by rereading the first with the same codec, so a consistent writer-reader corruption can leave both texts equal and this assertion green.
follow-on: the added tests only exercise synthetic export rows, codec round trips and spline values; no assertion fails if the measured case labels, row coverage or tie-island offsets regress.
